bio_from_owner_raw: Residents and businesses in Hollywood count on Ferny House Painters of Palmetto Bay for dependable painting services tailored to their needs. Whether it's interior painting, home painting, cabinet painting, or commercial painting, our experienced team is committed to delivering beautiful results with exceptional attention to detail. Let us help
bio_note: El texto 'From the owner' de la ficha de Google menciona otras zonas (Hollywood, Palmetto Bay) que no coinciden con Kendall: parece texto de plantilla generica de un proveedor de fichas/SEO, no se usa literal en el site. Se usa solo la info verificada (nombre exacto del negocio, direccion, telefono, categoria 'Painter', reseñas).
fotos_fuente: Google Maps (fotos publicadas en la ficha del negocio, via scripts/gmaps_detail2.js). Se descartaron 2 fotos de cocinas con aspecto de render/stock no verificable como trabajo propio y 3 duplicados exactos.

reviewSamples.author: ali chekhali
reviewSamples.text: I recently hired Kevin for a house I just bought to paint and I must say, it's rare to find such honesty and quality work these days.

reviewSamples.author: Liam Coleman
reviewSamples.text: Our kitchen and hallway look completely refreshed after the team finished. They protected our furniture and worked around our schedule without any issues. The colors dried beautifully with no streaks. It feels like a new space. We couldn’t be happier.

reviewSamples.author: Connor Bailey
reviewSamples.text: The painters helped us freshen up our living room and den. They took their time prepping the walls which helped the final finish look perfect. The colors pop beautifully now. Cleanup was done thoroughly after each day. We highly recommend their services in Palmetto Bay.

reviewSamples.author: Jolie Thompson
reviewSamples.text: Our living room and hallway look completely refreshed. The lines are clean and the finish is very smooth. Professional painters who really know their craft.

reviewSamples.author: Glenn Antonio Thompson Jr.
reviewSamples.text: Kevin’s work was excellent! Pricing is reasonable and I’m happy with the final paint color scheme. Thank you for a job well done Kevin.

language_note: Sin Instagram/Facebook propios para evaluar idioma de posts; las reseñas de Google (la unica fuente de voz del negocio) estan en ingles. Se usa 'en' como idioma principal.
pricing_note: No hay precios publicados en ninguna fuente verificable. Cards de servicios sin precio + nota de cotizacion.
